sources.snippet: We present Nanbeige4.2-3B, a compact general agentic model with 3B non-embedding parameters. It delivers strong performance across code-agent, office-agent, and complex tool-use tasks while maintaining highly competitive reasoning capabilities in mathematics, coding, and science. sources.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Nanbeige4.2-3B is a compact 3B-parameter agentic language model using a Looped Transformer architecture that reuses transformer layers to boost capacity without adding parameters. It combines strong tool-use and coding-agent performance with broad reasoning across math, science, and general agent benchmarks, supporting configurable thinking and tool-calling modes for multi-turn agentic workflows.
